ENISA is looking to fill in a post of a Senior Cybersecurity Expert to support the Policy Monitoring and Analyses Unit activities.
 

Type of contract: Temporary Agent
Function Group and grade: AD8
Area: Policy Monitoring and Analyses Unit (PMA)
Place of Employment: Athens, Greece
Probation period: 9 months
Reserve list: 31/12/2029
Deadline for applications: 12/10/2026 at 23:59:59 Greek time

How to Apply

Apply using our recruitment platform.

Applications must be submitted by 23:59:59 (Greek time) on the closing date.

You are strongly advised to submit your application well in advance of the deadline, since heavy internet traffic or fault with the internet connection could lead to difficulties in last-minute submission.

Apply here

  • Vacancy type:Temp Agent
